caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with an angular, corner-form design, consisting of three backrest sections connected at right angles. The chair features ornate, cabriole-style legs, each ending in a small pad foot. The backrest segments include three vertical splats with decorative curves, and the armrests extend outward, with rounded, scrolling ends. The seat is trapezoidal, upholstered with a muted greenish cushion. The wood is rendered in warm brown tones, with shading indicating depth and curvature. The chair is centered on a plain, light beige background, with a thin rectangular border sketched around the edges of the paper. The artist’s name, “Lorenz Rothkranz,” is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Corner Chair
